notes_for_editor: Record point 35.16472, -77.23166 is about 150 m from the NGS mark position (35 09 53.94 N, 077 13 59.67 W); not corrected, since the tower and mark may not share a spot. Do not confuse with the NHLR Wilmar Fire Tower (Craven County, about 35.39 N, 77.14 W), a different tower about 25 km north, not used here. The 1975 description and the 2003 recovery note are the only evidence; nothing found says whether the tower stands now. The 2003 note covers the survey station, not the tower. Facts height_m 27.4 is the NGS overall height, not a cab-floor height.
